chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from more than one person, from Yūnus, from ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام, who said: I heard him say:

The sunnah (prophetic tradition) regarding carrying the جنازة is that you face the side of the bier with your right side, then hold the left side with your right hand, then move along it to the other side from behind it to the third side of the bier, then move along it to the fourth side that is by your left.

key_terms.السَّرِيرِ: the bier on which the deceased is placed
key_terms.الْجَانِبِ الثَّالِثِ: the third side, indicating the sequence of movement around the bier
key_terms.الْجَانِبِ الرَّابِعِ: the fourth side, completing the prescribed order
key_terms.الْجَنَازَةِ: the funeral bier or deceased being carried for burial
key_terms.اَلسُّنَّةُ: the normative prophetic and Imamic practice to be followed
key_terms.بِشِقِّكَ الْأَيْمَنِ: with your right side, indicating the prescribed bodily orientation
key_terms.بِكَفِّكَ الْأَيْمَنِ: with your right hand, specifying how to take hold

ai.seo_question: What is the sunnah (prophetic tradition) method of carrying a جنازة according to Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the sunnah (prophetic tradition) manner of carrying a جنازة, describing an ordered way of taking hold of the bier from its sides. Its significance lies in preserving proper funerary etiquette and transmitting the practiced form of respect for the deceased.
